name: Marcela Saracay
headline: Co-Founder & Operations Manager
about:
Implementation Specialist and Agile project manager with 8+ years of experience managing implementation projects for SaaS companies. Served as the primary lead with clients throughout the project lifecycle of discovery, planning, training, in-depth testing and analysis, go-live, and post-implementation support. I also had the fortune to motivate and guide extraordinary teams. I delivered over 100 implementation projects using the scrum framework and agile methodologies. And I take a data-driven approach to drive continuous improvement of our processes and set clear team goals to maintain a change management attitude, driving my team to excel in processes and knowledge being amongst the best in the company.
 
I am a native English and Spanish speaker, certified in Agile Project Management.
… more
